listen_address.description: IP address for papd to bind to; use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: UDP port to listen on for PAP requests (standard AppleTalk PAP port).

pap_active.description: Enable PAP service — if false, no printers will be accessible via AppleTalk.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of print jobs papd will accept per printer at once.

queue_timeout.description: Seconds after which queued jobs are purged (0 = never purge).

syslog_enabled.description: Log messages to syslog — recommended for production use.

debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debug logging — use only for troubleshooting.

printcap_path.description: Path to the printcap file describing available printers.

default_command.description: Template for the shell command used to submit print jobs (variables: job, printer).

printers.description: List of printers to expose via PAP. Each printer is mapped to an AppleTalk name.

name.description: Unix/CUPS printer name (must match a queue in printcap).

at_name.description: AppleTalk name for this printer (max 15 chars; must be unique).

queue_name.description: Print queue name (often same as 'name' for CUPS).

command.description: Command template (optional override of DefaultCommand). Use {{job}} and {{printer}} placeholders.

default_printer.description: Name of the default printer (if empty, first printer in PrintCap is used).
